name: Breakfast
description: Breakfast word search puzzles celebrate morning plates — bagel, berry, cereal, toast, omelet, juice and dawn — for adults and seniors who like a gentle start. Free online; easy through hard plus large print. Parent theme: Food. No café brands, no timer, no account. Pairs with Coffee & Tea, Kitchen and Baking. Use large print when early light is still dim, or read how to play if you are new to Words at Rest.
